supplied_clip.view: rear tracking camera; supplied crop contains the top character only

timing_aid.method: temporal correlation of lower-body grayscale appearance at 30 fps
timing_aid.qualification: Appearance-based timing estimate affected by camera and scenery; not recovered skeleton motion.

visual_observations: The head and upper body remain relatively steady.
Weight transfers laterally through the hips while the shoulders counter-rotate.
Arms and elbows overlap the torso motion rather than moving as one rigid unit.
Wrist distance from the hip varies through the swing; hands look relaxed.

authored_choices.method: Original cyclic key-pose curves for hips, torso, arms and wrists, plus constrained foot trajectories and a relaxed hand pose.
authored_choices.depth_and_angles: Artist estimates adapted to the DayZ rig, not measured 3D joint coordinates.

limits: Rear view obscures forward/back limb depth.
Feet are partly cropped during some contacts.
The tracking camera prevents absolute speed or body dip measurement without calibration.
revision_feedback: v04 torso appeared rigid. v05 distributes delayed twist, bend and flex across all four spine joints and lets the head partly follow. Amplitudes are authored estimates.
